{{Quote|Do not underestimate the Sith. Though quaint, they will do whatever it takes to survive.|Valkorion|<ref name="Brothers" />}}
During the fifth [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic War|renewed warfare]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Eternal Empire]] made an '''attack''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. It was part of a series of preliminary [[Eternal Empire raids|raids]] by the Empire, which up to that point had been concealed to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], as a test of the strength of the border worlds of the Republic and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].

Korriban was a prime target for the Eternal Empire, due to the presence of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] for the training of [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Acolytes]]. The [[Twin/Legends|twin]] [[Prince/Legends|princes]] [[Arcann]] and [[Thexan]] led the assault of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] [[Knights of Zakuul]], facing fierce resistance. Arcann was critically injured during the battle, suffering severe burns and the loss of an [[Limb/Legends|arm]] and an [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. However, the following [[Standard day/Legends|day]] [[Gender/Legends|he]] was on his feet again and [[Death|executed]] the Sith [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Darth Atroxa]]. Despite the efforts of the Sith, the Knights of [[Zakuul]] breached the Sith Academy during the fighting.

The attack was a tremendous defeat for the Sith, while the Eternal Empire only suffered moderate casualties. Following the battle, the forces of the Eternal Empire withdrew, eventually heading back to their [[Throne/Legends|throne]]-world of Zakuul. Shortly afterwards, the Republic and the Sith Empire joined together to [[Destruction of Darth Marr's flagship|find]] the source of these unknown aggressors.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Look around you. Zakuul is poised to become the greatest civilization in the history of the galaxy. I have forged this empire to surmount all of my previous works. To span eternity.|Valkorion|audio=ValkorionZakuul.flac|<ref name="The Hunt" />}}
Located in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="Online">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Horuset system]]</ref> [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]]<ref name="Sith Empire">{{Holonet|allegiances|sith-empire|The Sith Empire}}</ref> as well as the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> though the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] saw the ruin of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Sith Empire" /> [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], grew weary of the restraints placed upon [[Gender/Legends|him]] by the Sith and his Empire.<ref name="Dream of an Empire">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=2}}</ref> Freeing himself, he [[Essence transfer|split his consciousness]] into a new body, a man named [[Valkorion]].<ref name="Valkorion">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Valkorion}}</ref> He then set to work forging a new empire from the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]], which became the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="Zakuul">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Zakuul}}</ref> The new realm became immensely powerful, all the while remaining concealed from the rest of the galaxy in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="The Hunt" />

[[3681 BBY|Centuries later]], the Sith Empire returned to the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]], initiating the [[Great Galactic War]] against the unsuspecting Republic. Early in the war, the Sith [[Battle of Korriban|stormed]] Korriban, overwhelming the few Republic defenders.<ref name="Timeline">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> The abandoned [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]], previously used three [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] earlier during the [[Jedi Civil War]], once again saw use, turning out only the most powerful [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Acolytes]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

[[File:Thexan_and_Arcann.jpg|thumb|left|265px|Arcann and Thexan led the Knights of Zakuul in the raids.]]
Although the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] was signed [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later between the two opposing sides, the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|resulting tension]] between the Empire and Republic eventually overflowed, spilling into yet another [[Galactic War|war]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Around [[3636 BBY]], the fifth [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the conflict,<ref name="Date KOTFE" /> Valkorion's [[Twin/Legends|twin]] sons, [[Prince/Legends|Princes]] [[Arcann]] and [[Thexan]], proposed a plan to test the capabilities of the Republic and Empire in combat. Valkorion agreed, granting Thexan control of the [[Eternal Fleet]]<ref name="Arcann" />&mdash;an [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] operated by [[GEMINI|sentient droids]]&mdash;<ref name="Fleet">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|The Eternal Fleet}}</ref> though he ordered that Arcann remain on Zakuul. However, Arcann disobeyed his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] wishes and led the [[Eternal Empire raids|assault]] alongside his brother regardless.<ref name="Arcann" /> They fought on many worlds, before finally striking at Korriban.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

==The attack==
{{Quote|Acceptable casualties, on our side. Darth Atroxa remains a threat, but I'm confident she will be neutralized. With her downfall, victory will be ours.|Thexan|<ref name="Brothers" />}}
The forces of the Eternal Empire, composed of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], at least two [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] and one [[Warship/Legends|warship]] descended on Korriban, facing fierce resistance from the Sith's own [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|naval forces]]. The latter was comprised of<ref name="Sacrifice" /> [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Mark VI ''Supremacy''-class starfighters]]<ref name="Sacrifice" /><ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class Imperial interceptors]].<ref name="Sacrifice" /><ref name="Fury" /> Led by Arcann and Thexan,<ref name="Brothers" /> the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]<ref name="Knights">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Knights of Zakuul}}</ref> [[Knights of Zakuul]] and several [[Droid/Legends|droids]]<ref name="Brothers" /> advanced on the Sith Academy<ref name="Companions & Contacts">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{C|Companions & Contacts menu}}</ref> on [[Limb/Legends|foot]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />

[[File:Knights_defend_Arcann.png|thumb|right|300px|A handful of Knights defend Arcann while he is tended to.]]
They clashed with the Sith under the command of [[Darth Atroxa]]<ref name="Brothers" /> in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]], whose forces were composed of [[Sith Warrior]]s<ref name="Sacrifice" /> as well as Acolytes and [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseers]] from the Academy.<ref name="Star Fortress" /> During the battle, Arcann was grievously wounded. As several Knights stood guard,<ref name="Sacrifice" /> [[Medic/Legends|medics]] operated upon him. The prince was later taken away from the battle to an encampment, where he thrashed in pain for [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] before finally succumbing to [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]]. There, Arcann was further performed upon; by the end of the ordeal, he had been fitted with a replacement [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] arm and [[Eye/Legends|eye]]&mdash;the latter as a part of a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] mask made to protect the prince's burnt face and to intimidate his foes.<ref name="Brothers" />

While Arcann was incapacitated, Thexan updated Valkorion on the status of the battle via [[Holocomm/Legends|holocom]]. The emperor did not express concern over his son's injuries, remarking that Arcann had "paid the price for defiance" in leaving Zakuul. The following [[Standard day/Legends|day]],<ref name="Brothers" /> Arcann was on his feet again and led a renewed assault during an intense [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]]. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Atroxa, the Sith [[Commander/Legends|commander]], met her [[Death/Legends|end]] by the prince's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] after he used his cybernetic arm to twist her wrist and [[Sun djem/Legends|disarm]] her.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

[[Darth Hexid]] was among those Sith who joined in the defense, carving her path through the invaders until she was knocked out by an explosion.<ref name="Hexid">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Darkness Rising|Odessen}}</ref> Despite Sith resistance, the Eternal Empire stormed the Sith Academy,<ref name="Companions & Contacts" /> where Sith Acolyte [[Veeroa Denz]] [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] her [[Veeroa Denz's overseer|Overseer]], using the confusion to escape Korriban and the Sith.<ref name="Star Fortress" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|When I woke, I was surrounded by death and ruin. The Eternal Empire had conquered the Sith.|Darth Hexid|<ref name="Hexid" />}}
[[File:Departing_Korriban.png|thumb|left|300px|Arcann and Thexan depart Korriban via shuttle, leaving the Valley of the Dark Lords in ruins.]]
The attack was a crushing defeat for the Sith. Not only had they suffered heavy casualties, but considerable damage had been done to<ref name="Sacrifice" /> a prominent [[Sith academy|academy]] for the training of prospective Sith.<ref name="Korriban">{{Holonet|planets|korriban|Korriban}}</ref> The Eternal Empire also sustained sizable losses during the battle, though not as extensive as those of the Sith.<ref name="Brothers" />

As a result of the attack, many Acolytes fled and settled down to live their lives without interference from the Sith or the Eternal Empire, such as Veeroa Denz on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]],<ref name="Star Fortress" /> while Darth Hexid despised the weakness of the Sith who bowed down to the Eternal Empire and went to wage her own personal vendetta against Zakuul.<ref name="Hexid" /> When the raids were concluded, the forces of the Eternal Empire returned to Zakuul. A joint Republic-Sith taskforce led by [[Darth Marr]] was dispatched to locate the source of these unknown assailants. During the ensuing [[Destruction of Darth Marr's flagship|skirmish]] with the Eternal Fleet, forces of the Sith Empire identified the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of the Fleet as belonging to the same faction that had earlier attacked Korriban.<ref name="The Hunt" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Attack_on_Korriban_concept_art.jpg|thumb|250px|Arcann injured on the battlefield]]
The attack on Korriban made its first appearance in the cinematic trailer [[Sacrifice (cinematic trailer)|''Sacrifice'']], released on [[June 15]], [[2015]]. The trailer promoted the then-upcoming expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', titled [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']]. The attack served to establish how Arcann sustained his injuries and received his cybernetic replacements, which led to his change of personality to a darker tone.<ref name="Sacrifice" />
